title: CRM & API Integrations

listing.shortDescription: Connect CRMs, APIs, databases, communication platforms and third-party services.
listing.fullDescription: Integrations are where most systems quietly break. We build them defensively: contracts validated at the boundary, webhooks verified and replayable, pagination and rate limits handled properly, and every sync observable. When a third-party API changes, you find out from an alert rather than from a customer.

deliverables.title: Integration architecture
deliverables.description: Source of truth per entity, sync direction, conflict rules and field mapping.

deliverables.title: Resilient connectors
deliverables.description: Signature-verified webhooks, replay support, backoff and idempotent writes.

deliverables.title: Data hygiene
deliverables.description: Deduplication, normalisation and validation so your CRM stays trustworthy.

deliverables.title: Monitoring
deliverables.description: Sync health, drift detection and alerts when a downstream contract changes.

useCases: Two-way CRM synchronisation with an internal platform
Consolidating data from several systems into one warehouse
